narration.text: One AI voice cloner sounds totally indistinguishable from humans.
At number five is ElevenLabs. Still a powerhouse for professional voice generation, but it is paid and can be complex if you are just starting out. It is better suited for experienced users.

Coming in at number four, Speechify. It is great for converting text to speech quickly. However, its voice cloning capabilities are not as advanced as others on this list, making it less ideal for deep customisation.
In third place, we have Play.ht. This tool is a solid all-rounder. It offers an excellent voice library and good customisation options, making it a strong contender for various projects.

Number two is Murf.ai. It boasts an intuitive interface and impressive voice customisation features. Murf.ai makes it easy to create expressive and realistic voiceovers, standing out for its user experience.
And the top spot goes to Descript. It is simply the best for natural, real-time voice cloning. Its AI is so accurate, you can edit speech like text, creating truly seamless audio.
Descript's free tier makes it the clear winner. Did I get the number one spot right?
